visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark, wavy hair and silver bow-shaped earrings speaks directly to the camera with a bright, expressive smile and frequent hand gestures. She is positioned against a clean, white, brightly lit background that suggests a studio setting. (2) The scene shifts to a closer shot of the woman's face, now without makeup, showing her skin texture clearly. She holds a white and gold Elixir product tube to the camera before applying the cream to her face and neck using her palms in a smoothing motion. (3) She presents a black Shu Uemura concealer bottle and uses a small, thin makeup brush to carefully dab and blend the product into the inner corners and under-eye area of her face. (4) The woman showcases an okhee makeup brush and a Bobbi Brown cushion foundation compact. She uses the puff to press the foundation onto her nose and cheeks, followed by applying cream blush from BEIGIC jars with her fingers and blending it with a fluffy Salone brush. (5) She demonstrates contouring with an I'm Meme stick on her forehead and nose, then applies highlight from a Hince stick. She proceeds to detail her eyebrows with a Benefit pencil, applies eyeshadow from a Dasique palette, and adds Dior highlighter to her nose tip and eye corners. (6) In the final phase, she curls her lashes with an electric tool, applies eyeliner, and finishes with KAI Beauty mascara and lip products from NARS and Artesinsa. The video concludes with her posing and tilting her head to showcase the completed, glowy makeup look under the same bright studio lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a cheerful, friendly tone with clear articulation and moderate conversational intensity. An upbeat, major-mode pop background track with a steady electronic beat and synth chords starts simultaneously, maintaining a consistent 110 BPM. (2) As she describes the makeup steps, a soft mechanical click is heard as a product cap is removed. The voice maintains a high-arousal, positive valence, shifting slightly in pitch during emphasis. The BGM continues as a steady rhythmic layer beneath the speech. (3) A subtle 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition into a new product demonstration. The speaker's pacing remains brisk but professional, with short structural pauses between sentences. The mix is clean with high spectral clarity and very low ambient noise floor. (4) In the final phase, the voice takes on a more finalizing and satisfied tone. The BGM remains continuous and cheerful, blending perfectly with the narrator's celebratory closing remarks. The audio concludes with a smooth fade-out of both the vocal track and the instrumental music.
